title: New Zealand expresses concern over China lawmaker ban after Taiwan trip
description: New Zealand ​said on Thursday it would express its concerns to Beijing after China banned four New ‌Zealand lawmakers from entry following their visit to Taiwan last month.

title: Diplomatic Tensions Rise Over New Zealand Lawmakers' Taiwan Visit
description: China has barred four New Zealand lawmakers from entering the mainland, Hong Kong, and Macau after their visit to Taiwan, igniting diplomatic tensions. The move, seen as retaliation for the May visit, could be amended if apologies are extended by the lawmakers, indicating a complex international relationship.

title: East-West Leadership Lessons for a Volatile World

title: Reading between China’s red lines
description: NEW HAVEN, Connecticut — Chinese President Xi Jinping sent an unmistakably tough message on Taiwan to United States President Donald Trump during their summit in Beijing in mid-May. Xi warned that if the issue was handled poorly, China and the US would “collide or even clash,” creating an “extremely dangerous situation.” He stressed that Taiwan holds the key to Sino-American relations.

title: China rebuked as Czech Senate chief defends Taiwan ties, rejects Beijing's pressure
description: Czech Senate President Milos Vystrcil strongly pushed back against Beijing's attempts to influence Prague's foreign relations during a visit to Taiwan, declaring that China has no authority to dictate whom the Czech Republic chooses as its partners.
